_comment: Cross-driver contract of the About submenu's version row, written by hand. The row names the running build and the commit it was built from: a release shows its version, a build that is not a stamped release says it is local, a package whose stamp holds no usable version says its version is unknown, and a commit that cannot be determined is spelled by its own key, never guessed. keys maps each build kind (and the unknown commit) to the locale key every driver reads; each key's value carries the placeholders listed in placeholders (named, substituted once, left to right, so a value is never re-read as a placeholder or as a pattern). The vectors use the fake templates below, never a locale's wording, so they pin the formatter and not a translation. Every port replays this file: the shared Lua module _shared/lua/updater/version_label.lua (one test per Lua driver) and the AHK port Updater_VersionRowLabel in windows/modules/updater/core.ahk (tests/unit/test_version_label_vectors.ahk). An empty commit means the commit is unknown; the file uses no JSON null.
